title: Get Shop Videos Performance Details
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-09-28
html:
Path: /analytics/202609/shop_videos/batch_performance

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns detailed performance metrics for the requested videos.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
video_ids []int Y [7523456789012345678] The IDs of the shop videos whose performance details are requested.
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
start_date_ge string Y 2024-09-01 Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days.
end_date_lt string Y 2024-09-08 End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days.
granularity string N ALL Granularity of the data.
Available values: ALL, 1D
Default value: ALL
  • ALL: aggregate
  • 1D: daily | currency |string |N |USD |Currently, only local currency is supported in the response.

Available values: USD, LOCAL Default value: LOCAL

  • USD: US dollars
  • LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202609/shop_videos/batch_performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&video_ids=[7523456789012345678]&start_date_ge=2024-09-01&end_date_lt=2024-09-08&granularity=ALL&currency=USD

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^latest_available_date string 2024-09-07 Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).
^videos []object Performance details for the requested videos.
^^error object Error information when performance details for this video could not be returned.
^^^code string 300001 Error code for this video.
^^^message string Invalid video ID. Error message for this video.
^^performance object Performance details for this video. Returned when the video is processed successfully.
^^^intervals []object Interval data for the requested time range.
^^^^end_date string 2024-09-08 End date of the interval, exclusive.
^^^^sales object Sales performance data.
^^^^^overall object Overall sales performance data.
^^^^^^ctr string 0.029 Product clicks from the video divided by impressions of all video products.
^^^^^^customers int 12 The total number of customers who placed orders directly from the shoppable video.
^^^^^^gmv object Gross merchandise value generated directly from the shoppable video.
^^^^^^^amount string 230.02 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^^^^currency string USD Currency code in ISO 4217 format.
^^^^^^gpm object GMV generated per 1,000 video views.
^^^^^^^amount string 230.02 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^^^^currency string USD Currency code in ISO 4217 format.
^^^^^^items_sold int 22 The total number of items sold directly from the shoppable video.
^^^^^^product_clicks int 21232 The number of product clicks from the video.
^^^^^^product_impressions int 32092 The number of impressions of all video products.
^^^^start_date string 2024-09-01 Start date of the interval, inclusive.
^^^^traffic object Traffic performance of the video.
^^^^^comments int 8 The number of comments received by the video.
^^^^^likes int 2 The number of likes received by the video.
^^^^^new_followers int 11 The number of new followers attributed to the video.
^^^^^shares int 23 The number of times the video was shared.
^^^^^views int 76649 The number of video views.
^^^viewer_profile []object Viewer profile of the video.
^^^^age_distribution []object Distribution of viewers by age range.
^^^^^age string 25-34 Viewer age range. Possible values: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55+.
^^^^^percentage string 0.293 Percentage of viewers in this age range, expressed as a decimal between0 and1 .
^^^^country_distribution []object Distribution of viewers by country or region.
^^^^^country_code string MY The region of the viewer's TikTok account.
^^^^^percentage string 0.993 Percentage of viewers from this country or region, expressed as a decimal between0 and1 .
^^^^gender_distribution []object Distribution of viewers by gender.
^^^^^gender string MALE Viewer gender. Possible values: MALE, FEMALE.
^^^^^percentage string 0.349 Percentage of viewers of this gender, expressed as a decimal between0 and1 .
^^^^type string VIEWERS Viewer profile type. Possible values: NEW_FOLLOWER, VIEWERS.
^^video object Basic information about the video.
^^^duration int 10 The video duration.
^^^id string 7523456789012345678 The video ID.
^^^play_url string https://example.com/video.mp4 The video playback URL.
^^^thumbnail_url string https://example.com/thumbnail.jpg The video thumbnail URL.
^^^title string Summer collection The video title.
^^^username string shop_creator The username of the video creator.
^^^video_post_time string 1725148800 The time when the video was posted.
^^video_id string 7523456789012345678 The requested video ID.
